// PROBE for tests/unit/unshared-policy-count-is-the-customers-disclosure.test.ts.
//
// A second surface reading the customer's disclosure flag. Harmless-looking and
// exactly the shape the halt's decision rules out: the flag decides what an
// advisor is told about someone else's record, so every reader of it is a
// disclosure path that must be reviewed. Not compiled — the guard reads it as
// text, and would list this file as an unsanctioned reader.

export async function agentBookSummary(agentUserId: string) {
    const relationships = await db.customerRelationship.findMany({
        where: { agentUserId },
        select: { policyholderUserId: true, unsharedCountDisclosed: true },
    })

    return relationships.map((relationship) => ({
        customerId: relationship.policyholderUserId,
        holdsMore: relationship.unsharedCountDisclosed,
    }))
}
